[EN] I ran into that I told you about.
[ES] Me topé con ese del que te hablé.

[EN] You'll get your money when I get the World Tree sap.
[ES] Recibirás tu dinero cuando consiga la savia del World Tree.

[EN] No tricks, scoundrel, or the Free Traders Collective will put a bounty on your head.
[ES] Sin trucos, sinvergüenza, o los Free Traders Collective pondrán precio a tu cabeza.
